Then I pressed 'Create an image or sticker' and the bubble turned grey. When I pressed it, a black note said 'This model does not support temporary chat. test_cases.what_happened: I was on the pictures page when I opened the list. At the right edge, in the grey strip, a cross from the page behind happened to show through, so I pressed it. The list closed and I was back on the pictures page where I had been, not closed out of the pictures as well. Then I pressed 'Sketch' and closed the drawing panel with the cross at its left. It closed, and I was back at the pictures. Both went without hunting. But I noticed afterwards that when the list is opened over an ordinary page, no cross shows through the grey strip, only the edge of the page, so I was helped by luck rather than by the list itself.
